'''Maire''' was one of [[Colavaere]]'s attendants. She disappeared shortly after telling [[Faile]] of what Colavaere revealed to her about her plans to take the Sun Throne once [[Rand]] disappeared. She is presumed dead at Colavaere's hands.

Maire was first mentioned in ''[[A Crown of Swords'']], Chapter 5, "A Broken Crown."

Source: [http://www.ugcs.caltech.edu/%7Ekarlh/wot.cgi?book=ALL&type=chron&desc=final The Compendium of Wheel of Time Characters]
